title: IUIC gave aid and hope to our people in Jamaica after Hurricane Melissa!
cleanTitle: IUIC gave aid and hope to our people in Jamaica after Hurricane Melissa!
segments: When Hurricane Melissa hit Jamaica, it
didn't just damage  buildings. It
disrupted lives. Families were left
without basic necessities. Homes were
torn apart. Brothers was left to figure
out how to rebuild the very little.
That's when we stepped in. We sent
barrels filled with essential supplies,
food, clothing, everyday necessities
directly to the heads of the island. But
we  didn't stop there. One of our
officers, Officer Maka, lost part of his
home in the storm. Instead of just
training about it, we put action behind
our faith. We brought with us one of our
senior  construction leads,
Officer Bezel, to do a damage
assessment. When disaster strike, it's
all about how you respond. When our
people need help, we respond.
>> One brother [snorts] fall, everybody
falls, everybody  chipp, you
know, everybody work together. You know,
it was good. And that that is what we we
not just speak, but we put everything in
action, right? Just like the
commandments, we don't just speak the
commandment, but we do the
commandments, right? And what we're
doing is charity. So, anybody talking
about they have faith and they're not
forward thinking about maintaining and
building Israelite institutions, they
are full of it.
>> We put action behind our faith. Boats on
the ground.
